nodes.description: Tranche constructor: reads factory data via msg.sender, sets immutable position, underlying, interestToken, unlockTimestamp and decimals.
Internal override called from ERC20Permit constructor; performs two delegatecalls to the DateString library using storage slots of name and symbol.
View aliasing of valueSupplied returning the total principal token supply.
External deposit entrypoint: pulls underlying from msg.sender into the position then calls prefundedDeposit.
Public prefunded deposit: checks unlock timestamp, calls position.prefundedDeposit, computes adjusted amount, updates valueSupplied/interestSupply and mints yield and principal tokens.
External redemption of principal tokens: applies speedbump pro-rata logic, burns tokens, updates valueSupplied and withdraws underlying from the position.
External function to trigger the speedbump when position holdings are below valueSupplied after unlock.
External redemption of interest tokens: burns yield tokens, computes accrued interest pro rata and withdraws underlying.
Immutable IInterestToken minted/burned by this tranche.
Immutable IWrappedPosition holding the underlying assets.
Immutable IERC20 underlying token transferred in on deposit.
uint128 outstanding amount of underlying redeemable by principal tokens.
uint128 total supply of interest tokens.
Immutable timestamp after which redemptions are allowed.
Timestamp when a loss was first signaled, blocks redeems for 48 hours.
Caller address; used for token transfers, burns and factory identity assumption.
Block timestamp used for unlock, speedbump and deadline checks.
dateLib.delegatecall to DateString.encodeAndWriteTimestamp writing to name/symbol storage slots.
External call to position.prefundedDeposit returning shares, usedUnderlying and balanceBefore.
External call to position.withdrawUnderlying transferring underlying to a destination.
External call minting interest tokens for the deposit destination.
External call burning interest tokens from msg.sender.
External call pulling underlying from msg.sender into the position contract.
External call reading the underlying value of the vault holdings.
Internal _mint/_burn ERC20 balance updates and events.
Amount of underlying to deposit in deposit().
Mint destination in deposit().
Mint destination in prefundedDeposit().
Amount of principal tokens to burn in withdrawPrincipal().
Underlying destination in withdrawPrincipal().
Amount of interest tokens to burn in withdrawInterest().
Underlying destination in withdrawInterest().
Cached speedbump state variable.
Computed amount of underlying to withdraw, possibly pro rata.
Cached uint256 value of valueSupplied.

edges.reason: Constructor assumes msg.sender is the trusted TrancheFactory and reads configuration from it.
_extraConstruction treats msg.sender as the factory and uses its returned data for the delegatecall payload.
deposit transfers underlying from msg.sender into the position contract.
withdrawPrincipal burns principal tokens from msg.sender.
withdrawInterest burns interest tokens from msg.sender.
Deposits are gated by a block.timestamp < unlockTimestamp check.
WithdrawPrincipal enforces block.timestamp >= unlockTimestamp and a 48h window after a speedbump.
hitSpeedbump writes block.timestamp to the speedbump state variable after an unlock check.
WithdrawInterest requires block.timestamp >= unlockTimestamp.
deposit uses the underlying token reference for the transferFrom.
deposit forwards the underlying into the position contract address.
deposit makes an external transferFrom call to an untrusted token before state settlement.
deposit delegates the accounting to the public prefundedDeposit function.
prefundedDeposit calls the external position contract for a prefunded deposit.
prefundedDeposit relies on position values that can be influenced by an external contract.
prefundedDeposit mints yield tokens through an external call.
prefundedDeposit mints principal tokens before returning, interacting with ERC20 state.
prefundedDeposit updates valueSupplied with unchecked uint128 casts and divisions.
prefundedDeposit updates interestSupply with uint128 casts and usedUnderlying additions.
_extraConstruction issues two delegatecalls to the DateString library contract.
The delegatecall payload writes string names shared with the ERC20Permit state.
withdrawPrincipal reads position.balanceOfUnderlying via an external call.
withdrawPrincipal makes an external withdrawUnderlying call to the position contract.
withdrawPrincipal burns principal tokens before performing the external withdraw.
withdrawPrincipal updates valueSupplied with uint128 subtraction casts.
withdrawPrincipal reads and relies on the speedbump state to gate pro rata withdrawals.
localSpeedbump caches the speedbump state variable.
withdrawAmount is derived from the principal amount parameter and holdings ratio.
localSupply caches the valueSupplied state variable.
hitSpeedbump reads total holdings through an external position call.
hitSpeedbump compares holdings against valueSupplied to decide whether a loss occurred.
hitSpeedbump sets the speedbump state variable once a shortfall is detected.
withdrawInterest burns yield tokens through an external call.
withdrawInterest reads the vault underlying value via an external call.
withdrawInterest performs an external withdrawUnderlying call to the position.
withdrawInterest decrements interestSupply with uint128 casts and divides by the supply.
withdrawInterest reads valueSupplied to compute accrued interest.
The external withdrawUnderlying call can reenter withdrawPrincipal before state finalization.
The external withdrawUnderlying call issued by withdrawInterest can reenter the tranche.
The external prefundedDeposit call can reenter the deposit accounting path.
The external ERC20 transferFrom may invoke a malicious token callback reentering deposit.
The external interest token mint call can call back into the tranche before state is finalized.

normalization_plan.reason: deposit amount parameter flows directly into the deposit entrypoint.
deposit destination parameter is consumed by the deposit entrypoint.
prefundedDeposit destination parameter is consumed by that function and forwarded to mint.
withdrawPrincipal amount parameter is burned and used in the pro rata calculation.
withdrawPrincipal destination parameter is forwarded to the external withdrawUnderlying call.
withdrawInterest amount parameter drives the burn and redemption calculation.
withdrawInterest destination parameter is forwarded to the external withdrawUnderlying call.
localSpeedbump is a cached copy of the speedbump state used only inside withdrawPrincipal.
withdrawAmount is a temporary computed inside withdrawPrincipal.
localSupply is a cached copy of valueSupplied used only inside withdrawPrincipal.
